stage_0_prior_art: Search primary literature, patents and commercial APG compositions before claiming novelty.
Separate known APG replication from genuinely new feedstock or structure questions.
stage_1_input_definition: Use one precisely identified purified alcohol as positive control.
Use one well-characterized petroleum-derived alcohol cut only after GC/LC compositional profiling.
Keep crude oil direct-mix condition only as a negative control, not as the main synthesis route.
stage_2_controls: at least three independently prepared batches per candidate

required: LC-HRMS or validated equivalent detects predicted homologous/oligomeric series within instrument-qualified mass tolerance
NMR confirms both glycosidic and hydrophobic structural features
chromatographic method quantifies residual glucose, alcohol and major product distribution
mass balance and isolation distinguish product from emulsion or matrix carryover
stage_3_structure_gate.rule: No single FTIR band, emulsion image or mass peak is sufficient.

required: concentration-dependent surface or interfacial tension curve
reproducible breakpoint consistent with aggregation where applicable
emulsion performance compared with blank, physical mixture and commercial APG under identical conditions
confidence intervals reported across independent batches
stage_4_function_gate.threshold_rule: Do not use a universal <30 mN/m threshold. Pre-register a comparator-based superiority or non-inferiority margin because APG chain length and degree of polymerization shift CMC and surface tension.

stage_5_statistics.principle: The independent synthesis batch is the inferential unit; technical repeats do not substitute for independent batches.
stage_5_statistics.minimum_design: At least three independent batches for screening; larger confirmatory sample size determined from pilot variance and a preregistered effect size.
analysis: report effect sizes and confidence intervals
adjust for multiple comparisons when screening many candidates
retain all failed and negative batches
stage_5_statistics.five_sigma_boundary: Five sigma is not copied mechanically from particle physics. A chemical discovery claim needs orthogonal identity evidence, contamination controls, batch reproducibility and independent replication.

sequence: OECD 301/310-ready biodegradability only for a sufficiently characterized test substance
algae and daphnia testing before vertebrate testing where appropriate
use OECD threshold/reduction approaches to avoid unnecessary fish testing
lifecycle carbon, solvent, catalyst, energy and waste accounting

stage_7_independent_replication: share preregistration, reference standards and analysis plan
second laboratory repeats synthesis and characterization independently
claim survives only if structure and primary functional endpoint replicate

claim_ladder: LEVEL_2: structure assigned with orthogonal evidence
LEVEL_3: isolated product reproduced across independent batches
LEVEL_4: interfacial function confirmed against controls
LEVEL_7: novelty supported by prior-art review
LEVEL_8: application claim supported by lifecycle and field-relevant evidence
